messages:
sam: Heads-up — Acme (acct: acme-corp) keeps hitting 429s since 09:14 UTC but the Console quota panel shows ~120k tokens remaining for the month. Ticket from CS just came in.

support-bot: Created internal case INC-3456 and pinged eng oncall.

jess-oncall: Can you drop an example request + response? Need quick repro to escalate.

sam: Repro snippet from the customer: 
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-acme-XXXXX' \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-neo-8b","input":"hello"}'
```
Response: 
```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2026 09:16:02 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
X-Request-Id: req_01F...
X-Rate-Limit-Reason: token_bucket_empty

{"error":"rate_limited","message":"quota exceeded"}
```

sam: Customer says they called ~4 calls/min which should be within their reserved throughput.

jess-oncall: Thanks. I pulled the enforcer logs for that account around 09:16 UTC: 
```
[09:15:58] enforcer INFO key=acct:acme-corp:monthly tokens=0 seq=1843 source=redis
[09:16:01] enforcer WARN token_bucket_empty key=acct:acme-corp:monthly reason=writeback_applied
```

kai-ingest: I looked at the metrics pipeline. Aggregator commit lag spiked around 09:10 — downstream transformer was OOMing and a retry loop replayed a checkpoint at 09:12. That job reapplied a snapshot with seq=1840 that came from an older processing window. The snapshot write path currently overwrites Redis keys unconditionally.

ryan-billing: So dashboard shows 120k because the OLAP materialized view (clickhouse) was updated later by the streaming dedupe? Console uses the view which got a backfill computed at 09:20 showing consumption lower than the instant Redis state. Enforcement reads Redis immediately and got stomped by the old snapshot write — leading to 0 tokens.

jess-oncall: That explains the mismatch. Quick checks: 
- kubectl -n infra logs aggregator-xyz | grep commit_lag (shows 650000 ms)
- redis-cli GET "acct:acme-corp:monthly" (shows 0)
- clickhouse query: SELECT sum(consumed) WHERE acct='acme-corp' AND month='2026-03' (returns value consistent with console)

sam: Immediate mitigation?

kai-ingest: Patch ready: guard snapshot writes with seq check (only apply if incoming_seq > current_seq). Deploying to staging now. Also will stop the failing transformer to let backlog catch up.

ryan-billing: For customer communication: I can offer temporary burst override (1h) while we reconcile. Will need approval from ops.

jess-oncall: Actions: 
1) kai -> hotfix seq-guard to aggregator (in review) (ETA 30m)
2) ops -> grant temporary override to acct:acme-corp (if approved)
3) infra -> run reconciliation job to reapply latest counts from clickhouse into Redis only if seq is newer (run after hotfix)
4) cs -> update Acme with ETA and workaround (burst window)

sam: Adding note to INC-3456 with logs and repro. I'll coordinate CS message. :thumbsup:

support-bot: INC-3456 updated: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3456

jess-oncall: Postmortem items: stronger guardrails on snapshot apply, alert on aggregator.commit_lag > 60s, and a canary for snapshot writes so we don't clobber live keys.

sam: Thanks all — will follow up once hotfix is live.
